name: Franklin FTSE South Korea ETF
thesis: Macro/factor position, NOT a single-name research thesis: FLKR is held as the cleanest liquid proxy for the memory-semiconductor (DRAM / HBM / NAND) up-cycle, expressed through Korean equities. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix dominate FLKR's top weights and are 2 of the 3 global DRAM makers; SK Hynix is the HBM leader and the lead NVIDIA HBM supplier. The bet: AI-driven HBM demand + DRAM/NAND supply discipline drives a multi-quarter memory pricing cycle that inflects Samsung/SK Hynix earnings, with Korea's 'Value-up' corporate-governance re-rating as a secondary kicker. Conviction: LOW (macro/factor, not fundamental). The position is already up ~+93%; it is held through the memory cycle and is governed by a manual price exit rule, not a fundamental break-rule set.
key_driver: DRAM/HBM/NAND memory pricing cycle (SK Hynix HBM leadership + Samsung scale); Korea 'Value-up' governance re-rating kicker

manual_sell_trigger.rule: Sell only when price is back above $70
manual_sell_trigger.rationale: Owner's stated exit discipline: hold through the memory cycle; only trim/exit on a recovery back above $70. NOT auto-enforced by the valuation ladder (an ETF has no DCF fair value), so this is a documented manual trigger that /review surfaces as the conviction note rather than a computed sell.

nuance.position_type: Macro / factor ETF proxy for the memory-chip cycle — not a bottom-up single-name thesis. Conviction low; sized as a thematic sleeve.
nuance.why_korea: FLKR's top weights are Samsung Electronics + SK Hynix — the Korean memory oligopoly. SK Hynix leads HBM (primary NVIDIA supplier); Samsung is the scale DRAM/NAND player. Korean equities are the most direct liquid expression of the memory-ASP cycle without single-stock idiosyncratic risk.
nuance.bear_case: Memory is deeply cyclical: a DRAM/NAND ASP roll-over, HBM oversupply, or SK Hynix losing HBM share to Samsung/Micron would break the cycle leg. Macro tails: sustained KRW weakness eroding USD returns, and Korea's persistent geopolitical / governance discount re-widening.
nuance.kicker: Korea 'Value-up' program — corporate-governance reform driving buybacks/dividends and a valuation re-rating of the chronically discounted KOSPI.

thesis_breakers_qualitative: DRAM/NAND ASPs roll over (memory cycle turns down) for 2+ consecutive quarters
HBM oversupply or SK Hynix losing HBM share to Samsung/Micron
Korea 'Value-up' governance re-rating stalls or reverses
Sustained KRW weakness erodes USD returns on the position
